messages:
jess: ALERT — customer alice-customer reporting a sudden 502/504 surge hitting hosted API during inference bursts, ~40% errors over a 30s window. trace_id=abc123:4567. anyone on call?

srebot: incident created INC-2026-1839 and attached ingress logs. :rotating_light:

omar: on it. which region and sample req?

jess: eu-west-1. customer pasted curl they used:  

jess: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Tenant: alice" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d @payload.json`

lina: scanning logs now — pattern shows ingress/nginx/upstream timeouts + upstream resets around the same window. snippet from ingress:  

lina: `[2026-11-22T12:34:56Z] 10.0.0.1 - - "POST /v1/generate HTTP/2.0" 502 0 "-" "python-requests/2.28" upstream: "10.10.45.78:8080" reset while reading response`

lina: also `recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)` and a few `upstream read timeout` entries. CPU on inference nodes spiked to ~85% at the same time.

omar: any 429s from auth proxy or spikes from billing?

lina: not 429s, but auth preflight latency jumped — some 401s during key swap windows. auth-cache TTL is 60s for this tenant.

jess: customer notes latency climbs before 502s. repro they used: fire 50 concurrent short requests, small payload, repeat for 1m. They see `HTTP/2 502` then immediate `Connection: close`.

omar: hypothesis: preflight auth service briefly returns failures or high latency during key rotation -> ingress retries/queues many streams -> upstream inference pods get connection window saturated and reset. Could be backpressure from auth->ingress->upstream chain.

lina: suggested quick mitigations: 1) bump auth-cache TTL for tenant alice 60s->300s 2) increase nginx `proxy_read_timeout` for the VIP to 90s 3) warm-route customer to a pool with spare capacity.

jess: I applied a temporary route to warm nodes and bumped read_timeout on the VIP; monitoring now shows error rate dropped from ~40% -> ~2% in ~2 minutes. customer confirmed reduced errors. :thumbsup:

omar: good triage. next steps (RCAs): 1) perf test to simulate preflight bursts and auth key-rotation overlaps (owner: lina) 2) add ingress circuit-breaker/fail-fast when auth preflight latency crosses threshold (owner: omar) 3) metric: auth preflight latency per-tenant + spike alert (owner: lina) 4) evaluate auth-cache per-tenant sensible defaults (owner: infra-team).

jess: I'll update the support ticket with mitigation steps and ask customer to hold off rotating keys for 24h while we stabilize. tagging alice-customer to confirm.

alice-customer: thanks — seeing much fewer errors now. we'll keep you posted if it pops back up.

omar: logging action items in ENG-OPS board and scheduling follow-up post-mortem. adding trace samples and the curl repro to the ticket.

lina: saved a sanitized ingress + envoy trace snippet to the incident:  

lina: ```
[envoy] upstream reset while reading response, stream_id=103, upstream_host=10.10.45.78:8080
upstream_response_duration_ms=4200
auth_preflight_ms=380
```

jess: thanks all. closing this thread for now, will reopen if customer reports recurrence.
